name: @edgegamers/jailbreak-core
description: Jailbreak round state, rebels, cells and the round log.

rebel_time.description: Seconds a prisoner stays a rebel after hurting a guard (css_edgegamers_jailbreak-rebel_time).

c4_give.description: Give a random prisoner a jihad C4 at the start of every round (css_edgegamers_jailbreak-c4_give).

c4_delay.description: Seconds between arming the jihad C4 and the explosion (css_edgegamers_jailbreak-c4_delay).

c4_radius.description: Jihad C4 explosion radius in units (css_edgegamers_jailbreak-c4_radius).

c4_damage.description: Jihad C4 damage at the centre; falls off linearly to 0 at the radius (css_edgegamers_jailbreak-c4_damage).

opencells_delay.description: Seconds after round start to auto-open the cells; -1 disables (css_edgegamers_jailbreak-warden_opencells_delay).

opencells_snitch.description: When cells auto-open, say how many prisoners were still inside (css_edgegamers_jailbreak-warden_auto_snitch).

logs_allow_dead.description: Also let dead players use !logs (the C# only allowed admins).
